About

Your trusted security partner.

Green Multikonsult och Säkerhet GMS AB is a Swedish security company in Umeå. We offer modern, tailored security solutions for businesses, property owners, public organisations and events.

  • 24/7Around the clock, all year
  • VU1+2Trained guards
  • 2022Founded in Umeå
  • 100%Tailored assignments
01

Our story

GMS was founded in Umeå in 2022 with a simple idea: security should be personal. We have grown by listening to our clients and delivering what we promise, day and night.

02

Social responsibility

We are a socially responsible company. Part of our mission is to reduce violence, vandalism and crime among young people and help build a safer society.

03

Training & skills

Our guards are trained to the Swedish VU1 and VU2 standard. All staff train continuously in technology, customer care, ethics and problem solving.

04

Support

You always have a contact person who knows your assignment. We follow up, report and adjust as your needs change.

Our values

Three words we live by.

  1. 01

    Safety

    Our promise to every person and business we protect: that they feel safe, every day.

  2. 02

    Trust

    Openness and reliability. We do what we promise, and we do it right.

  3. 03

    Integrity

    High ethical standards and full responsibility for everything we do, even when no one is watching.
